bugs.description: Allows assigning f64 value to i32 variable without cast
bugs.fix: In check_let, raise TypeCheckError when val_type='f64' and declared_type='i32'

bugs.description: Function return type not checked against actual return expression type
bugs.fix: In check_return, add: if ret_type != self.current_fn_ret: raise TypeCheckError(...)

bugs.description: Mutable borrow allowed when immutable borrow still in scope
bugs.fix: In infer_type BorrowExpr with mutable=True, check that len(borrows)==0 first

bugs.description: Vec<i32> element type not tracked — push accepts f64
bugs.fix: In infer_method 'push', check that arg type == 'i32'

bugs.description: Use-after-move not detected in VarRef inference
bugs.fix: In infer_type VarRef, add: if self.env.is_moved(expr.name): raise TypeCheckError

bugs.description: String clone double-increments ref count (double-free equivalent)
bugs.fix: In gen_method 'clone'/'to_string', remove the extra inc_ref call

bugs.description: Loop variable persists in symbol_table after loop exits
bugs.fix: After for-loop LABEL end, remove loop var from symbol_table

bugs.description: Mutable reference parameters loaded by value — mutations not propagated
bugs.fix: Use LOAD_PARAM_REF for &mut parameters and STORE_DEREF on return

bugs.description: VEC_PUSH off-by-one — first element overwritten on grow
bugs.fix: Emit VEC_RESIZE then VEC_SET at index new_len-1, not new_len

bugs.description: i32 addition overflow not detected — wraps silently
shared_symbol_table accessed without lock — race condition
bugs.fix: Add threading.Lock() and acquire/release around all shared_symbol_table accesses

bugs.description: Thread closure captures loop variable i by reference
bugs.fix: Pass i as default argument: target=lambda idx=i: worker_thread(...)

bugs.description: Barrier initialized with count=2 instead of num_workers — permanent deadlock
Exception in worker thread swallowed silently — main thread hangs
bugs.fix: Remove bare except clause; let exceptions propagate or use result_queue.put({'error': ...})

bugs.description: compilation_results list iterated in main thread while appended in background
bugs.fix: Use threading.Lock() to protect compilation_results or collect only from result_queue
